name: Dabeli
subtitle: a spiced potato bun from Kutch, pressed on a griddle and edged with sev and pomegranate

ingredients.note: with the cinnamon and clove below, this is dabeli masala

prepNotes: Dabeli means pressed, and that is the technique: the filled bun is pressed hard on a buttered griddle until the outside crisps.
The filling should be sweet, sour and hot at once. If it tastes of only one of those, it is not finished.

steps.text: Mix the ground spices with the tamarind and jaggery into a thick paste.
Fold this through the mashed potato with salt until evenly coloured, and spread it flat on a plate.
Press pomegranate seeds, roasted peanuts and coriander over the surface.
steps.tip: Pressed into the surface, not stirred through. You want them in every bite of the cut face.

steps.text: Slit the pav without cutting through, spread a little tamarind chutney inside, and fill generously.
Roll the open edges in sev so the filling face is crusted.
Griddle in butter, pressing down firmly with a spatula, until both faces are crisp and golden.
Serve hot with more sev, chopped onion and roasted peanuts alongside.

storage: Best hot off the griddle. The filling keeps 2 days refrigerated and is arguably better on day two; assemble to order.
